# Copy-ZbxTemplate

## SYNOPSIS

Copies a template to a new name on the same server.

## SYNTAX

```
Copy-ZbxTemplate [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>> [-NewName] <string> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Copy-ZbxTemplate cmdlet exports the template in -InputObject with configuration.export, renames the document to -NewName, gives every part a new UUID and imports it with configuration.import, so the copy is a template of its own rather than an update of the original. Items, triggers, graphs, discovery rules and dashboards come along. With -Force a template already named -NewName is updated from the copy. The command writes the copy only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Copy a template to change it safely

```powershell
Copy-ZbxTemplate -InputObject 'Web App' -NewName 'Web App v2' -PassThru | Select-Object HostName, TemplateId
```

The copy is a separate template: change it, link it to one test host, and the original stays as it is.

### Example 2: Preview a copy

```powershell
Copy-ZbxTemplate -InputObject 'Web App' -NewName 'Web App v2' -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names the template the command would copy, and copies nothing.
